answer: Randomized spot-check re-grade resists sybils: a random fraction of settled answers is independently re-graded by a fresh, disjoint jury, and any identity caught approving junk triggers an expanded onyx-dark audit of its whole history. A ring rubber-stamping its own fakes faces that basalt-hard sampling probability on every answer, so expected exposure climbs with the ring's activity — more fakes acting means more draws against them. Honest graders pass re-grades on merit, opal-clear. Precondition: re-grade juries are disjoint from the original and sampling is unpredictable.
